rule: Every number in this file is a declared hypothesis unless it names a fit. None is a measurement of the specimen or of an engine. The valve named inlet is the one with the larger seat; that assignment is itself a hypothesis (params/published-993-comparison.json).

valve_y_minus.guide_stations_source: stations of the guide bore fit, seen at both ends

valve_y_plus.guide_stations_source: from the port-side boss tip (station 25.048 - 2.978) to the top of the cam-end outside diameter (65.926 + 6.358); the middle is not acquired
valve_y_plus.spring_pocket_note: the fitted pocket of this valve is 34.3 mm in diameter; 18 mm also covers the pocket wall foot

valve.what: valve steel, one value for head and stem

plug.what: steel plug shell, insulator and electrode ignored

seat_inserts.what: not modelled: the seat rings carry the head alloy's conductivity

chamber_gas.what: cycle-averaged combustion gas on the chamber wall, the valve faces and the plug tips

hot_port.what: exhaust gas in the port of the exhaust valve and on the back of that valve

cool_port.what: charge in the inlet port and on the back of the inlet valve

cylinder_contact.what: contact through the floor of the register recess to a cylinder at one temperature; the deck plane outside the recess is in air

air.what: forced cooling air on every other face, cam side and plug wells included; 150 W/(m² K) lies inside Mackerle's bound of 116 to 233

oil.what: oil splashed on the spring pockets, the guide tops and the stems above the spring seats; 90 °C is inside the 80 to 100 °C of the workshop manual and the DDK forum records, the coefficient is declared

regions.chamber_source: the rule of sim_thermal.py: the fitted chamber shoulder radius
regions.register_source: half the fitted register recess diameter (113.36 mm, params/feature-fits.json)

zones.what: where peak temperatures of the head alloy are read: a band behind each seat, the land within reach of both seat circles (the valve bridge), a sleeve around each plug thread. Nodes shared with a valve, a guide or a plug are not counted as alloy

not_modelled: contact resistance at seats, guides, plug threads and the cylinder joint
seat inserts as a separate material
the cylinder itself and its fins
valve motion: both valves are closed
oil cooling beyond the spring pockets: no oil jets, no oil in the cam housing floor, no oil return tubes
material_skin_note: the united surface is extracted at 1.0 mm; a tetrahedron outside the CAD body and within this distance of a valve or plug solid is that part, not head alloy
calibration_rule: at the reference conductivity each calibrated coefficient is multiplied by target over achieved wall loading, calibration_steps times; the coefficients then stay fixed for every alloy of the variant

variants.what: the first declared case: gas at 900 °C and 400 W/(m² K), no oil film
the first declared case with the oil film added

gas at the effective 621 °C that NACA Report 612 measured on air-cooled aircraft cylinders; chamber and exhaust-port coefficients scaled until the walls carry the 465 and 145 kW/m² that Mackerle gives; oil film; air at 150 W/(m² K)
variants.status: hypothesis: published generic values applied to this head; no source describes it

variants.what: the same with the air film at Mackerle's upper bound of 233 W/(m² K)
variants.status: hypothesis: published generic values applied to this head; no source describes it
